title: Ansel and the Homecoming
author: Dominic Nakamura
blurb: Quentin Brightwater, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent fifteen years being so careful it hurts. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
